lane_surface.definition: L = pct_rank(||grad det_elev_slope||) * structure_tensor_coherence(det_elev); L_pct = pct_rank(L)
lane_surface.bands: training_features Band 12 det_elev + Band 19 det_elev_slope (masked reads, sentinel-safe)
lane_surface.implementation: gems/breakline.py (deriv sigma 1px, tensor sigma 2px, 1001-knot percentile ranks)
lane_surface.catalogue_use: none in L, keep ranking or refill weight; inherited d_cat>2.0px exclusion only

far_candidate_pool.rule: footprint AND valid topography AND d_cat>2.0px AND d_H19>3.0px AND not in R0; scan restricted to top-400k by L_raw

lane_surface.keep_rule: exact expected-DTI greedy (alpha 0.2 beta 0.8 R=3px) over R0 pixels only, w=0.30+0.70*L_pct on H19-5 support
lane_surface.refill_rule: spaced top-L: descending L_raw, 2.8px strict spacing floor (gems.breakline.spaced_top_mask) -- the emission rule from the pre-build screen; PASS-2 correction, exact-greedy emission superseded (evidence/breakline_*_exactgreedy_superseded.json)
lane_surface.uniqueness_by_construction: R0 and D2.8/SOLO are subsets of H19-5 (asserted in build); far dots are >3px from every H19-5 pixel, so whole-file fraction within 3px of any lineage raster equals the kept fraction (0.67/0.62/0.55) up to skeleton-adjacency of kept dots themselves, which is exact-shared only against R0. Measured against all local registry rasters in evidence/breakline_proxy_audit.json.
